name: 職員の休暇名称を改め子育て部分休暇を新設
summary: 勤務時間などの条例と給与条例で、「生理休暇」の名称を「健康管理休暇」に改めます。また、子が9歳に達する日と小学校等の第3学年を終える日のうち遅い方以後、最初の3月31日までの子を育てる職員に、「子育て部分休暇」を設けます。法律上の部分休業を受けられる職員は対象外で、公務に支障がある場合を除いて認めます。条例は令和8年4月1日に施行します。

en.name: Renames staff leave and creates partial childcare leave
en.official: Regarding the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Tama City Ordinance on Working Hours, Holidays, Leave, etc. for City Employees
en.summary: The ordinance on working hours and other matters, and the salary ordinance, rename “menstrual leave” as “health management leave.” They also establish “partial childcare leave” for employees raising a child until the first March 31 after the later of the day the child turns 9 and the day the child completes the third grade of elementary school or an equivalent school. Employees who are eligible for partial leave under the law are excluded. The leave will be approved unless it would interfere with public duties. The ordinance takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Rename “menstrual leave” as “health management leave” in the ordinance on working hours and other matters, and in the salary ordinance
